name: correo
description: Free business email on any domain. Cloudflare Email Routing receives, Resend sends DKIM-signed, your existing Gmail is the inbox — no mailbox to pay for. Ships a hardened script (correo.sh) whose every quirk is a bug already suffered: DNSSEC guards, orange-proxy detection, 'this domain already has someone else's email' refusal, and the unverified-destination trap that makes a setup look green while delivering nothing.
